data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is very proud to present this 1-bedroom apartment in Binghatti Skyrise Tower B, a new architectural landmark located in the dynamic Business Bay district.

Property Details:

1 Bedroom
2 Bathrooms
Open-plan living and dining area
Floor-to-ceiling windows
Fully fitted kitchen
Smart home features
Built-in wardrobes

Building Amenities:

Rooftop infinity pool & private man-made beach with cabanas
Tennis, basketball & badminton courts
Indoor & outdoor gym
Luxury spa, yoga & meditation zones

Strategically Located:

At the heart of Business Bay, Dubai
2 minutes from Dubai Canal
3 minutes from Burj Khalifa
3 minutes from Dubai Mall
5 minutes from Business Bay Marina
5 minutes from Dubai Opera

Binghatti Skyrise is a high-rise residential development by Binghatti Developers, strategically located in the heart of Business Bay. The tower blends bold architectural design with functional living spaces and luxury amenities. Residents will enjoy access to a swimming pool, fully equipped gym, landscaped areas, retail outlets, and covered parking. With direct connectivity to Sheikh Zayed Road and close proximity to Downtown Dubai, the location offers excellent convenience for both investors and end-users.

For more information, please don’t hesitate to contact us.
